title: Nested List Access
instructions: How do you access the element at row 1, column 2 of a `List<List<Int>>` called `grid`?
explanation: To access a nested list, use two sets of square brackets. The first bracket `[1]` selects the row (the second inner list, since indexing starts at 0). The second bracket `[2]` selects the column (the third element in that inner list).
